ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 12 Oct 1993. Sharmila D'Silva is the Current Fund Manager of ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹11,11,684 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 30 Oct 2026 is ₹113.46.
